source62_counterexample.proof: f(z)=-1/(z-pi)+G(z) for an entire G. Expanding the pole in negative powers of z converges for |z|>pi, while the entire part converges everywhere. Thus a Laurent expansion about0 also has infinite outer radius. Clue c4 incorrectly assumes the Taylor/interior region.
